title: Python Circular Imports: Why They Happen and How to Fix Them
description: Confused by Python circular imports? Learn why they happen, how Python's import system works, and how to fix import errors using practical examples.
summary: A Python circular import happens when two modules import each other and one of them isn’t finished loading yet. Python reports it as an ImportError or an AttributeError , usually with a message about a partially initialized module.
takeaways: A type-only import still needs a TYPE_CHECKING guard , even on Python 3.14, where annotations are evaluated lazily.
